title: Want Amazon Prime Free for Prime Day? This Phone Plan Has You Covered - NewsBreak
text: If you’re planning to cash in on Amazon Prime Day this year but haven’t signed up for a Prime membership, Metro by T-Mobile may have just saved you $139. As part of its Metro Flex Unlimited Plus plan, the prepaid wireless carrier is offering customers a full Amazon Prime membership for free. That includes access to all Prime Day deals, plus streaming perks like Prime Video favorites such as The Rings of Power , the newly launched We Were Liars , and live events like the National Women’s Soccer League. The offer comes at a timely moment. Amazon just announced that Prime Day 2025 will kick off July 16 and 17, setting the stage for one of the biggest shopping events of the summer. Related: Amazon’s Bold Prime Day Move Could Change How You Shop This Summer With prices expected to drop on everything from tech and fitness gear to outdoor essentials and everyday basics, having Prime access could pay off fast. But for Metro customers on the Flex Unlimited Plus plan, the Prime membership is more than just two days of discounts. It unlocks the full year-long suite of Prime benefits—free two-day shipping, Prime Reading, Prime Gaming, and early access to lightning deals—without any additional cost beyond their mobile plan. Related: This New Amazon-Roku Deal Could Change How You Watch TV There’s also a streaming advantage. Prime Video is increasingly competitive in the entertainment space, and has exclusive access to buzzy shows like We Were Liars (which premiered June 18). This benefit could be a major bonus for subscribers already stretching their subscription budgets. While Metro by T-Mobile hasn’t confirmed how long the free Prime perk will last, the inclusion of affiliate links on their site suggests they're leaning into the value of this bundled offer. And for mobile users who already rely on their phones to shop, stream, and manage their lives, combining wireless service with Amazon Prime benefits might be the ultimate life upgrade.
